recs.name: The Game of Chic
recs.tag: Utage's not too happy, but she's not gonna let you know that before this is over.

lines.x: You know me, Utage.
Every week, I shop at Sunset Boulevard, have afternoon tea at the Seven Points Hotel, find places to take some nice photos, and always, always have Higashinese cuisine for Saturday dinners.
But now? I had to borrow money to buy the latest Mango terminal, and I'm paying in installments too.
I'm broke, my dear. My wallet is as empty as my eyes.
So that's why you started selling this stuff at 'Origin Strife'? So what are those on the shelf?
Minimalist shoulder bags. The style is trending, so they're all sold out on Sunset Boulevard.
Didn't you use to call them 'pillow cases with shoulder straps'... Oh, and what are those? Slides?
Printed slides, to be precise. They're all the rage with people your age, didn't you know?
By the way, I designed those prints by combining the most popular patterns from the past five years. I have three designs to choose from, and I'm sure they'll be popular enough.
What happened to your older works? Like the 'Sexy Jail' and 'Dark Queen' stuff?
You used to love that 'Wild Jungle' series so much, but I only see a few hats from it... The burdenbeast pendants are gone too.
I... took the rest down.
Can I still buy them from you in the future?
I have to bid farewell to the past, my dear. Perhaps I could gift you a piece the next time you're here, but...
I'll be real with you: I really, really appreciate you always supporting my designs and hanging out with me. I cherish all my children too.
But they just don't sell. Ever since you left Lungmen, I have only a few regulars who drop by occasionally, and even fewer new customers.
More importantly, my dad stopped giving me money.
He recently married a Lupo woman and told me he can't afford to support me financially anymore. I have to rely on myself now, or I'll be out on the streets.
I... can't live the way I used to anymore, mooching off my dad and roping you in to work on my so-called art.
So.... have you made any money yet?
Currently... no.
Give it time! Believe me, I just need some time.
The high-end market may still be dominated by older brands like MARTHE and 0011, but you can find the trendsetters of today just about anywhere now.
'Minimalist,' 'Functional,' 'Neo-Retro,' 'Streetwear'... To seize a trend is to seize the future!
Just look at the stuff I have here. What customers want is 'real fashion' like this, not some artsy nonsense.
The overall sales volume speaks for itself, and combined with my talent... I'm sure someone will eventually discover the much better designs they can only get here.
Also... I applied for the Spring Pop Fashion Show under the Emerging Designers category, so I've been busy prepping for that too.
There won't be any big names there. It's mostly a showcase of trendy designs, so it'll be a pretty good chance for me to get some exposure.
Didn't you use to hate those big fashion shows?
You used to say they were... 'for egotistical bigshots, and full of incompetent designers trying every trick in the book to grab attention.'
Well, I thought it over again recently, and they're not that bad.
I was young then, and not desperate enough for cash...
Give it to me straight, Zizhen... do you really think your designs are inferior to those sold elsewhere?
At least their stuff sells.
Ah. Some nuisance is knocking on my door again.
Let's talk later, Zizhen. And gimme all those hats.
Same 20% discount as usual?
I'm sorry, my dear, but I can't do discounts anymore.
Anyway, maybe making a change isn't such a bad idea, Zizhen.
Hehe.
Alright, best of luck with your show.
A fashion show, hm? Haven't been to something like that in a real long time.
Hm... could be fun, once in a while.
A day before the Spring Pop Fashion Show
(Hmm... if my info was right, it should be here.)
Have a pleasant trip, ladies.
Did you hear? Mr. Blanche would never have attended a show with so many amateurs if he weren't stuck in a design rut and looking for inspiration.
I'd expect no less from a famous designer. Even the way he speaks and acts is extraordinary.
Ha, is he still on your mind? Tomorrow night is for socializing, so you can just have a few drinks with him then.
What nonsense are you on about?!
Hmm...
Excuse me, Miss. May I see your invitation?
Invitation? Oh, I'm so sorry, but I was in a hurry and forgot to bring it with me.
Apologies, but the pre-show cocktail party is invitation-only, so I can't let you enter without one.
Oh, this is how you're going to play it... Do you even know who I am?
A... fashionable looking student?
Surely you've heard of Mr. Blanche?
Blanche? That famous Leithanian designer?
Yeah. He's here at the party tonight, isn't he? I'll let you in on a secret, he's the organizer's special guest.
I did see him earlier...
*sigh* Let me just say, famous artists like him are pretty eccentric, and just love ordering people around.
I'm his assistant while he's in Lungmen. I was just with him, but he forgot an extremely important design draft at his studio.
So I went back to bring it over, but accidentally left my invitation behind.
Is that so? But I don't remember seeing you before... Can you show me any proof?
Well, you can come with me to look for Mr. Blanche.
That's...
But if we disturb him in the middle of an enjoyable conversation... Well, I don't even know what will happen.
Also, you said you don't remember seeing me, but do you remember the two ladies who just left?
Of course. One of them was wearing a red jacket, and the other a dark purple cheongsam.
You clearly forgot then. One of them was obviously wearing a bright purple cardigan from MARTHE's autumn collection, and the other a custom red cheongsam from EPOQUE.
You're kidding?! My memory has always been pretty good!
Do you remember what color Mr. Blanche's suit is then?
Of course! It should be... a dark gray suit?
You sure?
Yes, no... wait, let me think... Was it black? No, that's not it...
See? So no surprise you don't remember me... Ah, I've been dallying here for so long, I hope Mr. Blanche doesn't get mad.
Wait... Argh, why does the guy on the next shift just happen to be on break right now?!
Tell you what, you go in first and deliver your thing to Mr. Blanche, then I'll come in ASAP to verify everything. Don't forget.
Hehe, much appreciated.
Well, that was easy.
Alright, the next step is...
Oh, over there.
Hello there. Sorry to disturb you, Mr. Blanche.
You're...
I'm a university student from Higashi studying in Yan, majoring in art history and working part-time as a reporter for the school newspaper.
So, we're currently doing a segment where we interview and record the daily lives of well-known contemporary artists at work.
People see you as one of the greats of the fashion industry. You're a figure young artists admire and follow, as well as personal hero to me since forever.
Seeing how it's so rare for you to visit Lungmen, I thought I couldn't let this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity slip.
So, if you could just grant me an interview during the show...?
An interview? I don't have time in my schedule for that sort of thing.
I won't disrupt your schedule at all, I just need to follow you around and record some footage during the show.
Listen, child. There's a reason I've taken the time to come all the way to Lungmen and participate in a foreign fashion show held by a group whose names I don't even know—
It's because I crave true beauty... I have no time to play house with some student reporter while on my sacred quest.
Wait... how did you even get in here?
About that. I had a chat with my uncle about this event, and he gave me an invite I used to get in.
And if my article is good enough, he said he'd orchestrate a special fashion show back home, and invite famous designers from all over Terra. I'd be able to publish another article too.
You're aware that our clothing back home is pretty unique, right?
Of course I am! Higashi, was it...? Higashi...
Well, if it's just an interview... Let me see. If you promise not to interfere with my schedule, I do technically have a bit of time to spare.
R-Really? Thank you so, so much—so when exactly tomorrow...?
I'll have my assistant send you my address later. I'll arrive here tomorrow at nine-o-clock sharp, and you will attend the show with me.
But keep in mind that I loathe tardiness.
Have any of you seen a guest that looks like a university student?
Hey, Mr. Security. Over here.
Were you... talking with Mr. Blanche just now? You're really his assistant?
How could I possibly lie to you?
...Sorry for doubting you earlier.
No biggie. Fortunately, you let me in, and Mr. Blanche is quite satisfied.
Right, and I... want to ask you about a private matter.
What is it?
Oh, it's Mr. Blanche. He's planning to stay in Lungmen for a few more days, but didn't bring a bodyguard with him this time, so he's looking for a trustworthy local.
He left me to sort it out, and the pay's pretty generous.
So I was thinking... You guys were probably hired by the show organizers for the event's duration, right?
...Yes.
And you've been so professional about it too. Any chance you do personal commissions too?
I... Do you really think I'm capable?
Well, I still need to ask you some basic interview questions first. Just for form's sake, you know how it is... For example...
Right, can you tell me about the security arrangements for the show?
Sorry, but we're about to close for the day.
Oh, that's alright, I'm just looking.
Please come again!
She walks down the stairs until her feet are both firmly on the ground. Her thoughts suddenly shift, and she turns around.
The staff member is busy removing the last few items embodying the shop's history from the establishment Utage is all-too familiar with.
She knows that when she's done, it will take on a brand-new, bright and beautiful look.
Just like the neon-lit fashion shops on Sunset Boulevard.
The old signboard, which has remained unchanged for a long time, flickers twice before finally going out.
Phew...
Hah—barkeep, pour me another one!
That's your third one already, young lady.
Work's been so stressful, how else am I supposed to relax?
The more you drink, the more you forget all the little annoyances.
Didn't you change jobs a while back? You said the new place was a pretty decent designer brand shop. What was the name again...?
'Origin Strife.'
Yeah, wasn't it featured in some fashion magazine too? Recommended by the famous art critic 'Pink Katana,' even.

It used to be a tiny hole-in-the-wall, but suddenly exploded in popularity. My wife's been pestering me to go shopping there these last few days, but I feel like they sell the same clothes as everywhere else.
*sigh* Enough about that—
Evening.
Er, aren't you... the customer from earlier?
Thanks for taking care of the store while Zizhen's been busy with the fashion show.
Are you a friend of hers?
Well, I guess you could say that.
*sigh*... Running the store is the easy part; I can deal with customers just fine. The hard part is... managing the stock.
There have been more customers these days, and there's no space for all the new goods in the old warehouse.
So Miss Zizhen took a loan to rent a new warehouse and wants everything moved over.
Isn't the old one filled with all her pet projects? Must be a pain to move them.
Yeah, she left it so messy when she was handling it. It's a pain to sort out because she just stacked everything into a big pile.
I mean... I even found a bed and some toiletries in there!
Oh yeah, I spent a few nights crashing there.
Huh?
When I ran into some trouble and didn't want anyone finding out, I borrowed her place for a few days... It's ancient history now, don't worry about it.
It took me a few days of hard work just to move the new products out. Now all that's left is her old stuff.
I took a look at them... They're pretty good. More stylish than the current stuff. I don't get why she decided to change her style... *hic*
Enough thinking. *hic* I just need to put in some elbow grease.
You seem kinda drunk, maybe you should call it a night.
W-Who said I was drunk?! I have pretty good alcohol tolerance, I'll have you know! Just watch me! Barkeep, pour me another!
Oh, sorry for underestimating you. Guess I'll have to keep you company then.
Unfortunately I'm allergic to alcohol, so I'll stick to orange juice.
Who cares! Just drink!
(Tsk, tsk. She's definitely smashed if she bought that excuse.)
To your new life, and to 'Origin Strife'!
To 'Origin Strife'!
Ahh—this is great. Only... I'm feeling a bit dizzy...
Hehe, I'll let you in on a little secret. Zizhen can be pretty careless.
She used to keep the key on top of the door panel at the old warehouse, or else she'd lose it. Take care of her for me, alright?
Haha, you know it! But she's changed things up, and now it's under the rock right by the door!
But don't worry, just leave it to me.
Thanks, I knew I could count on you.
(Yawn)
Alright, that should take care of all the prep work, more or less.
Ah, now I'm excited for tomorrow's show.
She feels beads of sweat condensing on her palm, and curls her fingers as she puts her hand in her pocket.
She feels the cold metal as she removes it from her jacket.
A 'Wild Jungle' series burdenbeast pendant lies quietly in the palm of her hand.
Now this, this is cute.
Day of the Spring Pop Fashion Show
No, no, you're too kind. I'm not talented at all, I've just been fortunate enough to be taught by some amazing people.
I didn't plan any sort of surprise, really. I have so much more to learn from you all.
Sorry, please excuse me for a moment. I need to check on the show plan again.
(Things are going so smoothly thanks to that guy.)
(The clothes were a bit annoying, but at least it's over and done with. Next up, accessories... they should be keeping them around here, right?)
(Target spotted! Huh? Along with two security guards...)
Did you hear something from above just now?
Nope.
Was I just hearing things? It can't be—Ah! Why'd you just hit my head?!
What? Why would I do that? The models are about to change their outfits, so hurry up and move this stuff!
Don't play dumb with me! What's that in your hand?
My hand—? Huh? Where'd this hammer come from?
Man, you really...
Pfft.
Ah!
Shh—
How... what are you doing here?
Oh, I get it. You must be here with Mr. Blanche to check things over before the show begins.
...Does he really think I'm suited for the job?
Sheesh, stop worrying so much! I got it all settled. Just do your best!
Sure, I'll give it a try.
Utage? What brings you here?
Evening, Zizhen.
Oh, I know. You came to get the latest scoop?
...It's complicated. Anyway, gotta go.
Utage.
Need something?
Don't blame me. I know you're a big fan of my old work, and I'll definitely make it up to you later.
But you have to understand why I'm doing this. This is what it means to be a designer.
You like playful and pretty things, and your taste is impeccable. But you're still just a student.
You don't understand the true value of what I'm doing.
Heh. Maybe it's you who doesn't understand.
Fashion isn't always about coming up with the most appealing design. You don't get labeled 'fashionable' just because a ton of people like it.
But seeing how you think your work needs outside approval to become 'real' fashion, we'll just have to give everyone a good look.
Excuse me, but the show is about to begin and we need to clear the backstage, so if you two ladies could return to your seats...
Okay, I won't spoil your fun anymore. Please enjoy your... unique fashion show.
Miss Ye, I believe you're up first in the Emerging Designers category?
I am.
Hahaha. Today's going to be so eye-opening for those old-timers, right from the start.
(Swirling wineglass)
Utage...
Miss Ye? Miss Ye Zizhen!
I'm over here.... What's the matter?
I need to confirm something with you.
Calm down. What is it?

When I was backstage, I noticed that your showcase items didn't match the list you submitted beforehand. Someone claiming to be your assistant said you decided on a last minute change for a better reception.
How is that possible?! I told the head stylist about the draping issue with the top pieces earlier... How would he not notice?
The head stylist and I saw you talking to the person in question backstage earlier, so... it didn't seem too suspicious.
Could it be... Utage?!

The head stylist thought anyone already inside the event couldn't possibly be suspicious, and that every designer would be at the reception, so it was perfectly natural to send an assistant to carry out your changes...
But I was still a little uneasy, so I came over to confirm...
Stop the show! Stop it now! Let me go backstage!
I'm afraid... it's too late now.
Ladies and gentlemen, good evening to you all.
A warm welcome to everyone gathered here on this beautiful night to participate in our Spring Pop Fashion Show.
Without further ado, I will now hand the opening over to our emerging designers. These young artisans are the future of design, and their works will surely shine brightly on-stage.
First up are the brand new creations of Miss Ye Zizhen.
Wait—

Haha. It seems like Miss Ye here is a little shy, but truth be told, she has dedicated her all for this show. Why, just before I came on stage her assistant even handed me a special introduction to read.
'Inspired by the primitive jungles of Sargon, the power of life lies within the rugged rawness of nature, incorporated into a unique urban aesthetic to create an original style.'
Please enjoy the newest release from the 'Wild Jungle' series.
The brilliant lights seem to drip down onto the rough and wild patterns, like gold seeping from the remote wilderness into modern civilization.
The models carry on with their rehearsed poses, the contrasting juxtaposition of their shockingly exaggerated accessories and their outfits exuding an intense glamor.
Sir! Please wait! This is a mistake!
Stop! Stop the showcase!
It's so over...
Ye... Miss Ye.
Is this really your work?
No, it's not... I mean, yes, but it's an old collection I'd already abandoned! I didn't intend to showcase these!
It's so... exquisite! Brimming with the vitality of nature!
Primitivity and modernity, nature and civilization. Who knew they could harmonize so wonderfully in these designs?
The purest form of beauty—like how a child would look at things. Something I've been painstakingly searching for... you've actually given it form.
Miss Ye Zizhen! You've done some outstanding work here!
His voice is far from loud, but everyone present is sure they could clearly hear the famous designer's evaluation.
Then, applause erupts from all over the venue, finally forming a sea of congratulations.
Ye Zizhen sits back in her chair, unable to utter a word amidst the clamor and cheers.
Utage! So here's where you were, I've been looking for ya.
Evening.
Whoa! Got yer nails done again?
Isn't it pretty? I went with a darkcore look this time.
Ah, almost forgot why I was lookin' for ya. Y'know that 'Wild Jungle' series that's been all the rage in Lungmen these days?
Oh yeah?
What, ya don't? It got real popular after some show, and now we got brands everywhere in Lungmen makin' clothes and accessories in that fashion!
So, I wanted to ask yer opinion, seeing how yer the famous 'Pink Katana' and all... Hey!
That pendant ya got on! It's from that 'Wild Jungle' series, right?
Yup.
How do I put it? The line has an interesting concept, but the designer herself is a little boring. Basically, I'd only recommend buying one or two pieces from the collection.
But the sudden rise in popularity... tsk, tsk. Maybe just a coincidence?
Phew. I can relax now that I've gotten a positive review from ya.
Right, I hear the shop behind this line is offerin' a sale recently, twenty percent off! Interested?
That so? Then—
Time for another shopping trip.

recs.name: The Tale of Nuegiri
recs.tag: Just an ordinary high-schooler in Higashi. Definitely.

lines.st: Long, long ago...
War raged across Higashi, with many ambitious warlords lording over their own territories.
This is a story that takes place in one of these territories of no particular note, on a night of no particular note.
Several Bugyous patrol the empty city streets, carrying lanterns in one hand, gripping sword hilts with the other.
The houses that line the street are completely silent. Perhaps they have been abandoned, or perhaps their residents simply dare not make a sound.
Disease and war have made the city a bleak and gloomy place.
The Bugyous are used to nights like this, and continue to solemnly carry out their duties.
The daimyo who rules over the city is strong, wise, and virtuous. But even the greatest leader cannot make food and medicine appear out of thin air.
What fate awaits this city?
No one discusses it, but the same answer is on everyone's minds.

lines.x: Hey, do you hear something?
What?
I think it's coming from the rooftops.

lines.st: The Bugyous look up, hoping to find the wind or some kind of small, harmless animal, in a time of war like this.
What they find is a humanoid silhouette with a hunched back, thick limbs, long fur growing from its body, and a tail winding and twisting as though it has a mind of its own.
The strange monster hides on the rooftops, its face shadowed, with only a pair of lilac eyes staring at the Bugyous with a gleam of malice.
The Bugyous stare in stunned silence, daring not to avert their eyes, nor make a single movement...
Until the monster lets out an eerie, earsplitting cry.

lines.x: Kusooooo!
What is that thing?!
A-Accursed monster!
Drive it away!
(Roars)
You've angered it!

lines.st: The monster leaps, its purple eyes drawing a curve in the night sky, landing beside the Bugyous.
It swings its massive claws without hesitation at the Bugyou trying to shoot it.
The blow sends the Bugyou flying. He does not make a sound as he impacts a house by the street, causing it to collapse.
The other Bugyous attempt to scatter, but the monster's attacks are relentless.
Soon, only a single young Bugyou is left to face the monster, his sword offering little comfort in the face of such a foe.
His legs tremble. Unable to flee, all he can do is await his inevitable death.
With a roar, the monster bares its fangs and charges at him, the ground rumbling under its thick limbs.
Yet the flash of a blade coming down from the roof is even faster. The monster takes a couple of steps back, its arm injured, showing fear for the first time.
The daimyo himself has come, sword in hand.

lines.x: A-Aruji-dono! You should not be here! It's dangerous!
Vile monster! You'll pay for the harm you have done to my people!

lines.st: The brave daimyo has the upper hand at first, but he is mortal flesh and blood, and his strength alone is insufficient to overcome the mysterious creature.
Even as the daimyo's sword cuts the creature's flesh and draws its blood, its attacks do not cease.
The monster's black claw wounds the daimyo, and corrupt blood seeps into his body, draining the last bit of his strength.
As the daimyo falls to the ground, he sees a figure charging the fleeing monster.
It is the young Bugyou, who has mustered the courage to strike at the monster with no regard for his own safety, impaling its heart with his sword.
The monster's corpse hits the ground, and the night is silent once more. The smell of blood is the only reminder that remains of the terrible battle that just occurred.
The daimyo bestowed his own sword upon the young Bugyou, in recognition of the courage he displayed.
The young Bugyou became the daimyo's personal guard, and was granted the name of Nuegiri, an honor that would be passed down from generation to generation.
The daimyo himself contracted Oripathy that night.
The accursed illness invoked by the accursed beast did not crush the daimyo's virtuous heart. Knowing that his days were numbered, he devoted his last days to improving the lot of his city.
His son inherited his will and continued to develop the city, overcoming challenging times to enter an era of prosperity.
The mysterious monster, the Nue, became a local legend.
The Nue would appear periodically, announcing its arrival with its ominous call, whereupon the descendants of Nuegiri would pursue and kill it.
Defeating the Nue drives out bad luck and brings good fortune.

lines.x: Rhodes Island Liaison Office
So that's the Higashinese Legend of Nuegiri?
Yeah. They say that the Nuegiri clan continues to protect a certain prominent Higashinese clan, driving misfortune away and bringing in good fortune.
But there's no record of this daimyo, or what city he ruled.
That's because it's legend.
The goods check out just fine. Same corridor as usual.
Take a left at that corner there and you'll see a red sign marking the cargo elevator. Closure's storage room is two floors up.
There are three security checkpoints along the way. Just follow the signs and listen to staff instructions.
You Rhodes Islanders always have so much red tape. Can't we do that 'package for you, just sign here' stuff? Alright, I'll go through the waybills. You go and deliver the goods.
Me?
Quit babbling and go. Be careful not to get lost. Heaven knows the corridors in this place still confuse me, even though I've been here a bunch of times.
I'll be going, then.
A new Messenger? He's got the look of a first-timer.
That's what this job's like. People come and go all the time. You know how hard logistics work is, with all the dangers out there.
What about your old partner, that Parker kid? Did he quit?
He tangled with some beasts on a solo delivery, so he's gone back home to Rim Billiton to recuperate. Not sure how serious it is.
Well, glad he's alive, at least.
Which is why I got a new partner.
Uh...
(All the corridors look the same... I'm lost, aren't I?)
There isn't a single soul in sight. How did I even end up here, anyway?
Are you delivering to Closure's storage room?
Do you need a guide?
Oh, a schoolgirl? Thank you. Are you a patient here?
An operator too. Wanna see my hall pass?
Sorry, I just made assumptions because you look so young. May I trouble you to show me the way, then?
No prob. Lemme just...
Hey, you can't take that box!
Why not? It's for me.
But this stuff still needs to go through Rhodes Island's security checks—
I take care of it myself. Lookie—'Utage,' 'Cosmetics Series.' Happy? Or you think it might be an Originium bomb? How about I open it in front of you?
Well, there's no need for that... it's just... procedure... uh...
Flip around and walk straight until you hit the third door. Take the corner a good twenty meters after that, turn right, then pop down the corridor on the left and walk thirty meters.
Off you go, now. I got training. Byeee.
Wait, don't—
Is that what Rhodes Island operators are like? I guess 'free spirit' is the word for it...
I should tell the people at security that this operator named Utage took one of the packages.
Alright, let's move...
The Messenger does not realize that Utage has not left. She is hiding behind a corner, just out of sight.
Utage holds the box like it is the most precious thing she has ever held.
She follows behind the Messenger, completely silent.
So, you're really into Higashinese myths and legends?
Of course. That's why I became a Messenger, to see and learn new things. I ask people for local stories wherever I go.
Sounds like a Messenger thing alright. Although, I've actually heard a different version of the Nuegiri legend.
Oh? Let's hear it.
Well—

lines.st: The story takes place in the same city, but in this story, the daimyo was not a paragon of virtue and selflessness.
He was short-sighted and arrogant, little different from the bandits in the hills.
He was cruel and brutal, and carried a hatred of all ill omens.
He loathed the Infected, stopping at nothing to eliminate any he discovered.
The daimyo's reign over his territory was one of terror and misery.

Things came to a head when the daimyo was attacked by the Infected in a riot. Driven to desperation, the Infected had set a trap for the daimyo, who managed to escape, but not before contracting Oripathy himself.
The daimyo slew his assassins, then threw his sword, stained with Infected blood, to the ground in disgust.
He could not accept his end, to be brought down by a filthy peasant illness.
He ordered his servants, the Nuegiri clan, to protect everything he had—his city, his family, his status, and his reputation.
The Nuegiri were no longer just the guardians of the daimyo. They were also tasked with eliminating all the 'Nue' in the daimyo's eyes—
Be it people, armies, or Catastrophes.
To those on the outside, they were killing some kind of mysterious monster that threatened them.
The duty of the Nuegiri became a curse, a cycle.
A cycle they repeated generation after generation.
Countless innocent souls were branded 'Nue' simply because they learned the truth, and were eliminated in order to hide it.

lines.x: Today, the city is gone, but it is said that the Nuegiri clan still exists, operating in the shadows.
Taken under the wing of a major Higashinese clan, they continue to perform their ancestral duties, eliminating all 'Nue' so dubbed by their master.
...That's the version I know.
Such a wildly different story. Fascinating.

opts: Is that the end of the story?

lines.x: Doctor! When did you come in?

opts: The part about the daimyo being cruel and brutal.

lines.x: Oh, er, don't take it too seriously. I heard it in passing and I can't vouch for its authenticity.
It's just a story. What's a good story without a bit of exaggeration?
Why hasn't the new guy come back yet, though?
Are you here because you're expecting something important, Doctor?

opts: There are a few reports scheduled to be delivered today.

lines.x: I'm done with the waybills here. We need to go see Closure.
Did that slowpoke really get lost? I'm gonna have words for him.
Huh? What's that?
What's going on?!

opts: An alarm from the storage room.

lines.x: There are several operators standing by in the corridor leading to Closure's storage room.
Someone tripped the thermal alarms. Possible use of combat Arts in the area.
But there's no sign of fighting, only a cartful of goods.
That's the packages we brought in today! There should be a Messenger too. Where is he?
The operator shakes his head.
We're investigating the incident, Doctor. Please stay with us and be on guard.
Doctor?
A grown man doesn't just vanish into thin air like that, right?
The Doctor crouches by the side of the cart, catching a slight whiff of a certain scent.
A minute, sweet scent.
(Well, that was annoying.)
Utage looks down at the slightly dented cardboard box in her hands as she mutters irritably.
(I'm pissed.)
Agh! What a pain!
Utage puts the package on the table, along with her katana.
With her painstakingly-painted nail-adorned fingers, she takes a small knife and cuts the cardboard box open, revealing a tiny component between the layers of cardboard.
It is a delicate component connected to a tiny Originium battery.
Utage stares at the component. The smile is gone from her face.
Hello? Do you hear me?
Utage starts talking to the component, obviously a covert listening device.

lines.st: Back in the secret manor, she knew nothing of duty or responsibility; she was simply raised according to the elders' plans.
She did not know what lay outside the manor's walls; she did not even know enough to be curious.
For better or for worse, she demonstrated outstanding aptitude and easily passed the Nuegiri clan's rigorous training regimen.
She received her mission—
Become an ordinary Higashinese citizen, an ordinary high-schooler who likes to look good, a Rhodes Islander who keeps a low profile, and eliminate the 'Nue' in the name of her master.
It was an easy assignment. No one would ever find out who she was.
Her parents and the rest of the family had no doubt that she would become the next leader of the Nuegiri clan.
The final step to becoming leader was to complete her mission at Rhodes Island.

lines.x: Doctor, we found the Messenger leaning against a door, far off his route.
He was unconscious, cause unknown.

opts: Take him to the lounge and let him rest.

lines.x: But... if he—
This really couldn't be more suspicious—

opts: Trust me, everything will be alright.
I've checked the area. No sign of anyone.

lines.x: ...If you say so, Doctor. We'll take him to the lounge.

opts: Get the other operators out of here too.
There was no foul play here.

lines.x: I'm only gonna say this once. Doesn't really matter, since you're gonna record it anyway.
...Ahem.
I love my life here. I love hanging out with my friends. Everything on Rhodes Island is awesome, way better than the old manor.
Oh, I don't like training, but I loooooove skipping it.
Which is why—
If you send a spy to Rhodes Island, I'm gonna pick him out in like, five seconds.
I don't care which of you is into Rhodes. If you ever pull funny business like this again—
I'll be back to pay Clan Nuegiri a visit. And then, there won't be a Clan Nuegiri anymore.
Say hi to Mama and Papa for me.
Utage pivots as she draws her katana.
Cut cleanly in half, the pieces of the listening device fall into the trash can.
That stupid Messenger just had to try and fight back! He made me spill all this loose powder!
Maybe I should've given it a bit before slicing the bug. Could've had the folks back home teach him a lesson.
Gah! I'm PISSED!
Utage does not want to be an assassin or a spy, nor carry the burden of whatever 'ancestral duty' her clan keeps babbling about.
Utage does not like training. Being an operator can be rather exhausting, after all.
All she wants to be is a high-schooler, a real Higashinese JK.
Hey! Kirara!
Utage-chan!
What's that? The latest issue?
No way you're reading it without me!
Of course I'm not... I just got it.
Well, whatever. Let's hit up your room and I'll try out some new cosmetics on you!
A-Again...?
